3Jane USD3::USD3.what: 3Jane senior credit tranche on USDC · fintech receivables + crypto credit lines

BitFi Bitcoin::BFBTC.what: BitFi yield-bearing BTC · Ceffu custody, delta-neutral basis trades on Binance
BitFi Bitcoin::BFBTC.body: bfBTC is BitFi's yield-bearing BTC token, minted against BTC (native BTC, BTCB on BSC, hemiBTC on Hemi, BTC on Bitlayer) at a bfBTC–BTC ratio that BitFi's manager wallet posts each epoch. The BTC is held by Ceffu and mirrored 1:1 to Binance through MirrorX, where BitFi and partner quant teams run delta-neutral trades; their profit raises the ratio, and a loss would lower it. The yield is off-chain and BitFi's docs publish no proof of reserve, so the ratio is BitFi's word; RedStone carries it as a fundamental price feed. One token on Ethereum, BSC, Base, Bitlayer, Hemi, Core and Goat (on Ethereum, Base, Core and Goat it mints and redeems only through native BTC); the AILayer BFBTC is a plain 1:1 wrapper that earns nothing.
BitFi Bitcoin::BFBTC.backing: BTC in Ceffu MPC custody, mirrored to Binance via MirrorX
BitFi Bitcoin::BFBTC.yieldSource: perp funding rates and spot–futures basis from delta-neutral trades on Binance
BitFi Bitcoin::BFBTC.redemption: Request, then BitFi's multisig approves after a cooldown and you claim BTC on the same EVM chain or receive native BTC; fixed fee 0.000006 bfBTC (EVM) or 0.000012 (Bitcoin), minimum 0.0001 bfBTC

DOLA.what: Inverse Finance stablecoin · minted against collateral on FiRM fixed-rate loans
DOLA.body: DOLA is Inverse Finance's USD stablecoin, minted mostly by the FiRM Fed into FiRM, Inverse's fixed-rate lending market, and burned when loans are repaid; borrowers pay interest by holding and burning DBR (DOLA Borrowing Rights). The peg rests on that loop: above $1 borrowers mint at par and sell, below $1 they buy cheap DOLA to repay, and a Peg Stability Module swaps it against USDS. Some legacy supply is unbacked: bad debt from the 2022 oracle exploits on the now-retired Frontier market is still being repaid over time. Minting is on Ethereum only; DOLA on Arbitrum, Base, Optimism and other chains is bridged.
DOLA.backing: Over-collateralized FiRM loans (sUSDe, sDOLA/DOLA LP tokens, wETH, wstETH, wBTC, cbBTC, CVX, cvxCRV, INV and others), USDS (held as sUSDS) in the PSM, plus legacy unbacked Frontier debt
DOLA.redemption: PSM on Ethereum swaps DOLA for USDS at 0.998 (20 bps fee, capacity not stated); otherwise sell on Curve and other DEX pools

Green USD Stablecoin::GREEN.what: Ripe Protocol stablecoin · minted against CDPs, a USDC/USDG PSM and protocol pool mints
Green USD Stablecoin::GREEN.body: GREEN is the USD stablecoin of Ripe Protocol on Base and Robinhood Chain. It is minted in three ways: borrowers mint it against multi-asset collateral, a PSM mints it 1:1 for USDC or USDG, and Ripe's Endaoment mints it into its own Curve pool to hold the peg. In October 2026 borrower debt was only about a fifth of supply. The protocol-held assets identified covered roughly three quarters of circulating GREEN. A 2-of-3 Safe controls the protocol, with no time locks on most settings.

Green USD Stablecoin::GREEN.redemption: Redemptions against Ripe positions inside their redemption zone; the PSM redeem is allowlisted on Base and empty on Robinhood Chain; otherwise Curve pools
Green USD Stablecoin::GREEN.verify: About a quarter of circulating GREEN had no identified backing asset on 2026-10-15

Hastra AUTO::AUTO.what: Hastra staked wYLDS · funds near-prime US auto loans (Agora Data / Figure)
Hastra AUTO::AUTO.body: AUTO is a share token you get by staking wYLDS with Hastra. The staked capital funds a Democratized Prime pool of near-prime US consumer auto loans, originated by Agora Data and structured by Figure on Provenance. It does not rebase: its value in wYLDS rises, read from Chainlink Data Streams. It carries more credit risk than PRIME.
Hastra AUTO::AUTO.backing: near-prime US consumer auto loans (Agora Data originates, Figure structures), secured by the vehicles
Hastra AUTO::AUTO.yieldSource: interest paid by the auto borrowers, at a utilization-based rate minus a 0.5 % Hastra fee; Hastra targets up to ~9 %, not guaranteed
Hastra AUTO::AUTO.redemption: AUTO → wYLDS in one atomic step, no unbonding (fails while the price feed is stale); wYLDS → USDC through Hastra's operator-run redemption
Hastra AUTO::AUTO.issuer: Hastra (incubated by Figure and the Provenance Blockchain Foundation)

Hastra PRIME::PRIME.what: Hastra staked wYLDS · Figure HELOC lending yield
Hastra PRIME::PRIME.body: PRIME is a yield-bearing token from Hastra, a protocol incubated by Figure and the Provenance Blockchain Foundation. Users lock USDC for wYLDS (wrapped Figure YLDS) and stake wYLDS to mint PRIME, which earns interest from Figure's Democratized Prime facility that funds home equity lines of credit (HELOCs). Figure states it does not issue or sponsor PRIME.
Hastra PRIME::PRIME.backing: HELOC loans via Figure Democratized Prime
Hastra PRIME::PRIME.redemption: Unstake to wYLDS any time, then redeem wYLDS for USDC after an unbonding period subject to redeem-vault liquidity; one pending redemption per address

Hastra wYLDS::wYLDS.what: Hastra wrapper of Figure's YLDS · USDC in 1:1, SOFR − 0.5 % paid monthly
Hastra wYLDS::wYLDS.body: wYLDS is Hastra's custodial wrapper over YLDS, Figure's SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin. You mint it 1:1 with USDC, which Hastra uses to buy YLDS for its reserve. The price stays about $1; yield is paid monthly as extra wYLDS that you claim on the Hastra dashboard. It is the base token every other Hastra asset (PRIME, AUTO, SMB) is staked from.
Hastra wYLDS::wYLDS.backing: YLDS held 1:1 in reserve (Figure Certificate Company; prime money-market-type securities)
Hastra wYLDS::wYLDS.yieldSource: the YLDS reserve's interest, SOFR minus 0.5 %, distributed monthly as claimable wYLDS; staked wYLDS stops earning it
Hastra wYLDS::wYLDS.redemption: request_redeem / complete_redeem to USDC through Hastra's operator, batched (currently $2k minimum), can wait on banking hours, one pending request per address; or swap on Raydium

Hylo Leveraged SOL::xSOL::solana.what: Hylo leveraged SOL · ~3x at the 150 % target, no liquidations or margin calls
Hylo Leveraged SOL::xSOL::solana.body: xSOL is the leveraged half of Hylo's SOL pool: its price is the pool's TVL minus the virtual stablecoin backing hyUSD, divided by xSOL supply. Leverage moves with the pool's collateral ratio (about 3x at the 150 % target), there are no liquidations or margin calls, and it loses value to volatility decay in sideways markets.
Hylo Leveraged SOL::xSOL::solana.backing: the residual of Hylo's SOL LST pool after the hyUSD claim
Hylo Leveraged SOL::xSOL::solana.redemption: mint and redeem against the pool at flat, configurable fees

Hylo SOL Plus::hyloSOL+::solana.what: Hylo SOL Plus · SOL stake pool that pays holders 0 % staking yield, Hylo XP only
Hylo SOL Plus::hyloSOL+::solana.body: hyloSOL+ is a Sanctum SPL stake pool whose epoch fee is 100 %: every staking reward goes to Hylo, which uses it to boost hyloSOL and fund incentives, so holders get no staking yield at all. Its rate has stayed at 1.0000092 SOL epoch after epoch. Holders earn 5x Hylo XP points instead, whose value is undisclosed. It tracks SOL 1:1 and is fully SOL-backed (about 10.9k SOL, single validator).
Hylo SOL Plus::hyloSOL+::solana.redemption: withdraw as a stake account (permissionless, 5 bps); instant SOL withdrawals are gated to Hylo
Hylo SOL Plus::hyloSOL+::solana.verify: Not a yield token: 100 % epoch fee, so holders earn 0 % staking yield (points only).

Main Street USD::MSUSD.what: Main Street synthetic dollar · reserve attestation withdrawn Jun 2026, ~$0.54
Main Street USD::MSUSD.body: msUSD is Main Street Finance's synthetic dollar, backed by an issuer-run book of CME options box spreads and redeemable 1:1 only by KYC'd users out of a USDC buffer. Around 20 June 2026 its proof-of-reserves dashboard went offline and Accountable ended its attestation; the buffer ran dry, redemptions stopped and msUSD fell to about $0.06. It traded back to about $0.54-0.56 by October 2026 with no redemption path reopened, while lending oracles (Euler) still read 1.0.

Midas Fasanara Global Open::MGLO.body: mGLO is a limited-recourse note issued by Midas (through a compartment of a Luxembourg securitisation vehicle) that tracks Fasanara Capital's Global Diversified Alternative Debt strategy. The fund finances short-dated trade receivables: invoices sold by small and mid-size businesses, with payment owed by larger corporate debtors. Returns build up in the token's NAV, with no rebases or reward claims.

Midas Fasanara Global Open::MGLO.yieldSource: Interest and discounts on trade-receivables financing, reflected in NAV
Midas Fasanara Global Open::MGLO.redemption: KYC/greenlisted mint and redeem via Midas vaults; standard monthly cycle at NAV (about 35 days), with faster paid options (instant partial liquidity, OTC buyers) at a discount

Midas Fasanara Global::MGLOBAL.what: Midas tokenized certificate · tracks Fasanara Global Diversified Alternative Debt
Midas Fasanara Global::MGLOBAL.body: mGLOBAL is issued by Midas and tracks Fasanara Capital's Global Diversified Alternative Debt strategy, a short-duration private credit portfolio of SME asset-backed credit such as trade receivables and digital invoices across many countries. It is a security token issued from a bankruptcy-remote compartment of a Luxembourg securitisation vehicle; returns accrue to the token price via an onchain NAV oracle.
Midas Fasanara Global::MGLOBAL.yieldSource: interest on the underlying alternative-debt portfolio
Midas Fasanara Global::MGLOBAL.redemption: Midas-onboarded (KYC) holders; instant routes via liquidity sleeve/credit facility when available, otherwise standard monthly NAV redemption (~35 days)

Midas Fasanara ONE::mF-ONE.what: Midas tokenized certificate · tracks Fasanara Capital's F-ONE private credit fund
Midas Fasanara ONE::mF-ONE.body: mF-ONE is issued by Midas and tracks Fasanara Capital's F-ONE fund, which allocates to fintech-originated receivables, SME and real-estate-backed private credit, and market-neutral digital asset strategies (the fund uses leverage). A liquidity sleeve holds Midas mTBILL (tokenized T-bills) and a Fasanara Digital Pareto vault to fund faster redemptions. Returns accrue to the token price via NAV.

Midas Fasanara ONE::mF-ONE.yieldSource: private credit interest and market-neutral strategy returns of the F-ONE fund
Midas Fasanara ONE::mF-ONE.redemption: Midas-onboarded (KYC) holders only; instant from liquidity sleeve when available (fee), otherwise ~30-day notice + 5-day settlement; secondary transfers permissionless

PT apyUSD (apxUSD) Ethereum::PT-apyUSD-5.body: This is a Pendle principal token on apyUSD, Apyx's yield-bearing savings token that earns dividends from Bitcoin-treasury preferred shares backing apxUSD. The PT trades at a discount and redeems 1:1 for apxUSD (the accounting asset) at maturity on 5 Nov 2026. apxUSD is backed by preferred equity rather than cash, so its own price can move below $1.
PT apyUSD (apxUSD) Ethereum::PT-apyUSD-5.backing: apyUSD held in the Pendle SY, ultimately DAT preferred shares
PT apyUSD (apxUSD) Ethereum::PT-apyUSD-5.redemption: Redeem on Pendle for apxUSD-equivalent at or after 5 Nov 2026; before then, sell on the Pendle AMM

PancakeSwap::CAKE.body: CAKE is the native token of PancakeSwap, a multi-chain DEX originally on BNB Chain. It is used for governance, liquidity mining rewards and fee discounts; under Tokenomics 3.0 (2025) veCAKE locking was retired, emissions were cut and part of trading fees is used to buy and burn CAKE, with max supply reduced to 400M in 2026.

Pareto AA Tranche - FalconXUSDC::AA_Falc.what: Pareto credit vault senior tranche · USDC loan to FalconX
Pareto AA Tranche - FalconXUSDC::AA_Falc.body: AA_FalconXUSDC is the senior (AA) tranche token of Pareto's FalconX Credit Vault, where deposited USDC is lent to the prime broker FalconX. M11 Credit (Maven 11) curates the vault, handles credit checks and covenants, and runs the monthly epochs. Interest from FalconX accrues into the token's NAV. The junior BB tranche has reportedly never been funded, so the AA tranche has no first-loss buffer in practice.
Pareto AA Tranche - FalconXUSDC::AA_Falc.redemption: Monthly epoch redemptions for KYC/KYB-verified non-US accredited lenders (Keyring); 250k USDC minimum
Pareto AA Tranche - FalconXUSDC::AA_Falc.verify: Junior tranche reportedly unfunded: the senior AA tranche has no first-loss buffer.

Pareto Staked USP::SUSP.what: Pareto staked USP · loans to institutional borrowers through Pareto Credit Vaults
Pareto Staked USP::SUSP.body: sUSP is the ERC-4626 staking vault over USP, Pareto's synthetic dollar (not Piku's USP). The USDC or USDS used to mint USP is placed in Pareto Credit Vaults that lend to institutional borrowers; the interest goes to sUSP as a rising price (about 6.3 % APR, ~765k USP staked in October 2026). sUSP holders take borrower defaults through a lower conversion rate, after a protocol-funded stability reserve.
Pareto Staked USP::SUSP.backing: USP (stablecoins lent through Pareto Credit Vaults)
Pareto Staked USP::SUSP.yieldSource: interest from institutional credit lines in Pareto Credit Vaults
Pareto Staked USP::SUSP.redemption: unstake to USP; USP is minted and redeemed through Pareto, partly KYC-gated
Pareto Staked USP::SUSP.verify: Unstake cooldown and fees were not checked.

PayFi Strategy Token::PST.what: Huma Finance PayFi LP token · USDC lent to payment financing

Deposited USDC funds short-term real-world payment financing (PayFi), such as pre-funding of cross-border payments, and yield accrues to the token in USDC terms.
PayFi Strategy Token::PST.redemption: Redeem for USDC via Huma app subject to pool liquidity and any chosen lockup; or sell on DEX

Plasma USD::plUSD.what: Trevee's Plasma dollar, 1:1 USDT in a Midas vault · effectively wound down since Nov 2025
Plasma USD::plUSD.body: plUSD was launched on Plasma by Trevee (formerly Rings Protocol) in Oct 2025: USDT deposits go into a Midas vault curated by Midas and Mithras Labs and lent on Aave, Fluid and Euler, plUSD is minted 1:1, and staking it gives splUSD. Trevee rehypothecated deposits and had about $14.7m lent to Stream Finance when Stream's xUSD collapsed in Nov 2025; it shut down rehypothecation and says splUSD holders were made whole, but its Plasma TVL on DefiLlama fell from about $50m to zero by early 2026 and the Chainlink plUSD and splUSD feeds were scheduled for deprecation in Sept 2026. What the index still sees is the stranded Euler eplUSD-2 vault, about $2.9m of plUSD lent against Stream xUSD at 100% utilization with withdrawals disabled, whose accruing but unpaid interest shows up as a bogus 22% supply APR.
Plasma USD::plUSD.backing: USDT in a Midas vault on Plasma (lent on Aave, Fluid, Euler); part was lent to Stream Finance and is in recovery
Plasma USD::plUSD.redemption: no official redemption terms or wind-down notice found; the Trevee Earn app still routes to a stake page; Euler positions in plUSD cannot be withdrawn
Plasma USD::plUSD.verify: Treat as discontinued: token-lists marks splUSD DISCONTINUED, DefiLlama shows $0 Plasma TVL for Trevee since early 2026, and Euler's liquidation bot blacklists every plUSD/splUSD vault as collapsed-asset collateral. No primary Trevee statement on redemption status was found; check trevee.xyz or @Trevee_xyz before relying on any number here.

Re Protocol reUSD::REUSD.what: Re senior reinsurance tranche · SOFR or sUSDe rate + 2.5%, price accrues
Re Protocol reUSD::REUSD.body: reUSD is the senior tranche of Re, an on-chain reinsurance marketplace. Capital that funds Re's partner reinsurers, held as admitted collateral in a Regulation 114 trust, earns SOFR + 250 bps; capital kept on-chain earns the 7-day trailing sUSDe rate + 250 bps. It does not rebase: the price is reset daily at 00:00 UTC, by at most 50 bps per update. Underwriting losses hit the reinsurer's own equity first, then reUSDe, and reUSD last.

Re Protocol reUSD::REUSD.redemption: KYC, non-US only: instant at NAV from an on-chain buffer (daily and per-wallet caps), else a quarterly queue; or sell on market

Resolv wstUSR::WSTUSR.what: Resolv wrapped staked USR · ETH staking + perp-short funding, in recovery
Resolv wstUSR::WSTUSR.body: wstUSR is the non-rebasing wrapper of stUSR, Resolv's staked USR, and its value rises against USR. USR was backed by a delta-neutral pool of staked ETH (wstETH and others) and BTC hedged with short perps; staking rewards and funding were split between stUSR and the junior RLP tranche, with RLP taking a risk premium and absorbing losses. On 22 March 2026 a compromised minting key let an attacker mint about 80M unbacked USR; Resolv paused, and its May 2026 recovery plan paid 1 USDC per pre-incident USR (0.5 for post-incident) with claims open until 26 August 2026.
Resolv wstUSR::WSTUSR.backing: USR (pre-incident collateral pool: staked ETH/BTC hedged with perp shorts)
Resolv wstUSR::WSTUSR.yieldSource: ETH staking rewards and perp funding (historical)
Resolv wstUSR::WSTUSR.redemption: recovery claims via Resolv (1:1 USDC pre-incident) closed 2026-08-26
Resolv wstUSR::WSTUSR.verify: USR was exploited and depegged on 2026-03-22. The protocol went into recovery mode and the claim window ended 2026-08-26. Resolv is moving to Vault Street/primeUSD. Treat wstUSR as no longer earning yield; check current state before showing it.

Restaked Swell ETH::RSWETH.body: rswETH is Swell's liquid restaking token: deposited ETH is staked and restaked through EigenLayer, and rswETH's rate against ETH rises with staking and restaking rewards. The rate is updated in lumps (about 2.6 % APR over 90 days in October 2026, 5.1 % over 30), so short windows mislead. Bridged copies on several chains share this group.
Restaked Swell ETH::RSWETH.backing: ETH staked and restaked on EigenLayer through Swell
Restaked Swell ETH::RSWETH.yieldSource: Ethereum staking plus EigenLayer restaking rewards
Restaked Swell ETH::RSWETH.redemption: Swell withdrawal queue or a DEX sale
Restaked Swell ETH::RSWETH.verify: Restaked ETH can be slashed by EigenLayer services.

Resupply USD::REUSD.what: Resupply CDP stablecoin · minted against crvUSD/frxUSD lending positions
Resupply USD::REUSD.body: reUSD is the stablecoin of Resupply, a Convex and Yearn sub-DAO. Borrowers deposit crvUSD or frxUSD into a Resupply pair; the pair supplies it to a Curve LlamaLend or Fraxlend market, and that lending position is the collateral reUSD is minted against. The borrow rate is the highest of 50% of the underlying market's rate, 50% of the sfrxUSD rate, or 2%, and rises toward 60% while reUSD trades below $1. On 26 Jun 2025 a donation attack on the cvcrvUSD-vault (wstUSR) pair minted about $9.6M of reUSD against almost no collateral; the bad debt was covered by the treasury, a 6M reUSD burn from the Insurance Pool, donations and a Yearn loan.
Resupply USD::REUSD.backing: crvUSD/frxUSD lent on Curve LlamaLend and Fraxlend markets (themselves lent against WETH, wstETH, WBTC, sfrxUSD, sDOLA, syrupUSDC, sUSDe and others); Insurance Pool as first loss
Resupply USD::REUSD.redemption: Permissionless: burn reUSD against a chosen pair's collateral at $1 minus a 1% fee (the fee grows if crvUSD/frxUSD trade above $1); else sell on Curve

Royco Junior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-JT-apyU.what: Royco junior (first-loss) tranche on apyUSD · levered, impaired to ~0.87 per share
Royco Junior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-JT-apyU.body: ROY-JT-apyUSD is the first-loss tranche under ROY-ST: it earns its own apyUSD yield plus a premium from the senior and absorbs every apyUSD shortfall before the senior does. While its feed marked apxUSD at 0.88-0.99 between June and mid-July 2026, its NAV per share fell from 1.019 to 0.670 (about -34 %); it had recovered to about 0.87 by October. Its published ~33 % APR is recovery-inflated, and its ERC-4626 views return 0, so they cannot price it. Exits work as for the senior, limited by the coverage the senior requires.
Royco Junior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-JT-apyU.backing: apyUSD, subordinated to the senior tranche
Royco Junior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-JT-apyU.yieldSource: apyUSD yield plus the senior risk premium, net of losses absorbed
Royco Junior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-JT-apyU.redemption: request through Royco's EntryPoint, wait 1 day, execute; paid in apyUSD at request-time NAV; limited by senior coverage
Royco Junior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-JT-apyU.verify: First-loss and already impaired: ~0.87 per share in Oct 2026 vs 1.02 in Jun 2026; principal can fall further.

Royco Senior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-ST-apyU.what: Royco senior tranche on apyUSD · protected share of yield, junior takes losses first
Royco Senior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-ST-apyU.body: ROY-ST-apyUSD is the senior tranche of Royco V2's apyUSD market. It holds apyUSD, earns apyUSD's yield minus a premium paid to the junior tranche (ROY-JT), and is covered by that junior up to its size, about 28 % of the pool in October 2026. Its NAV is in dollars: apyUSD's share price times a Chainlink 'APXUSD / USD Exchange Rate' feed that reads 1.0, so an apxUSD market depeg is not marked. Senior deposits are capped by coverage. Exits pay apyUSD at the NAV of the request, so the day's yield while waiting is forfeited, and apyUSD's own exit takes 3-20 more days.
Royco Senior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-ST-apyU.backing: apyUSD (Apyx, backed by apxUSD), protected by the junior tranche
Royco Senior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-ST-apyU.yieldSource: apyUSD dividends minus the junior's risk premium
Royco Senior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-ST-apyU.redemption: request through Royco's EntryPoint (approve shares), wait 1 day, then anyone executes; cancel allowed before execution
Royco Senior Tranche apyUSD::ROY-ST-apyU.verify: The tranche can seize shares and blacklist accounts (role holder unverified); its oracle does not mark an apxUSD depeg.

Its value in USDa rises through Avalon's savings account, whose on-chain target APR was 4 % in October 2026 (1 sUSDa ≈ 1.132 USDa); the yield comes from USDa borrowing fees and Avalon's lending revenue. The same token runs on 13 chains under one group; Ethereum held about 516k sUSDa.

SUSDE.what: Ethena staked USDe · earns perp funding/basis + staked-ETH and reserve yield
SUSDE.body: sUSDe is Ethena's non-rebasing ERC-4626 vault for USDe; protocol revenue is periodically added to the vault, raising the exchange rate. USDe is backed by crypto assets (BTC, ETH, staked ETH) hedged with short perpetual/futures positions, plus stablecoins and short-duration RWAs. Yield comes from funding and basis spreads on the hedges, staked-ETH rewards and income on the stable reserves; when funding is negative stakers may receive nothing and the reserve fund absorbs losses.
SUSDE.backing: USDe (delta-hedged BTC/ETH/staked ETH + stablecoins and short-duration RWAs)
SUSDE.yieldSource: perp funding and basis spread, staked-ETH rewards, stablecoin/RWA reserve yield

SUSDX.what: Staked USDX (Stables Labs) · collapsed synthetic dollar

USDX lost its peg in November 2025 and fell to around $0.3 or lower, amid allegations that the team minted unbacked USDX/sUSDX to borrow against it. The Ethereum sUSDX contract now has a tiny supply and trades near $0.01.
SUSDX.backing: Nominally delta-neutral hedged positions; backing impaired after the Nov 2025 collapse
SUSDX.yieldSource: Nominally funding-rate and basis yield (no longer credible)
SUSDX.redemption: Cooldown-based unstake to USDX; USDX itself is not reliably redeemable
SUSDX.verify: Defunct: USDX collapsed Nov 2025; sUSDX trades near $0.01.

SUSN.what: Noon staked USN · T-bills, CLOs, private credit, DeFi lending + perp funding arb
SUSN.body: sUSN is Noon's staking vault over the USN stablecoin; Noon adds strategy returns by a daily rebase that moves USN into the vault, so one sUSN was worth about 1.23 USN in October 2026. USN reserves are spread across governance-approved strategies: tokenized T-bills, AAA CLO tranches, private-credit funds, DeFi stablecoin lending, principal tokens, looping and delta-neutral funding-rate arbitrage. Net returns are split 80/10/10 between sUSN holders, an insurance fund and operations. Ethereum holds the vault; the copies on other chains are bridged shares.
SUSN.backing: USN (reserves across T-bills, CLOs, private credit, DeFi and basis trades)
SUSN.yieldSource: T-bill, CLO and private-credit interest, DeFi lending, funding-rate arbitrage
SUSN.redemption: redeem into Noon's withdrawal handler (payout fixed at request), claim USN after 7 days, no cancel; USN mint/redeem only for KYC'd institutions ($1M minimum, up to 20 % of TVL a day)

Sierra::SIERRA.body: SIERRA is a USDC 'liquid yield token' issued by Sierra Reserve Ltd (BVI) on OpenTrade's LYT pool contracts. Deposited USDC goes to an issuer wallet and is lent to OpenTrade vaults: AAA CLOs, investment-grade commercial paper, Morpho Gauntlet Prime USDC, trade finance, a SOL basis trade and FalconX credit via Pareto. An operator sets each pool's exchange rate daily from those vaults, so SIERRA rises against USDC (about 5.4 % APR realized in October 2026). The native Ethereum pool and the Avalanche pool, whose token also circulates on Ethereum as a LayerZero OFT, keep separate rates (1.0411 and 1.0420 on 2026-10-16).

Sierra::SIERRA.yieldSource: interest and spreads from the OpenTrade vault basket, passed through a daily-set exchange rate
Sierra::SIERRA.redemption: mint and redeem only for KYB'd Authorized Participants (request, ~2 business days); everyone else trades it (Uniswap v4, ~0.2 % from NAV at $100k)
Sierra::SIERRA.verify: On Ethereum the pool admin and the reserve wallet are EOAs with no timelock; reserves are reported weekly (Five Sigma), with no full attestation.

Spark Savings USDC::SPUSDC.what: Spark savings vault on USDC · Spark Liquidity Layer lending + RWA allocation
Spark Savings USDC::SPUSDC.body: spUSDC is a Spark Savings V2 ERC-4626 vault on Ethereum; deposits of USDC mint shares whose exchange rate rises at a vault rate set by Spark governance. Deposits are deployed by the Spark Liquidity Layer across Spark's balance sheet: SparkLend, Aave and Morpho lending markets, tokenized RWA/T-bill strategies and Sky's sUSDS. A liquidity buffer serves instant withdrawals.
Spark Savings USDC::SPUSDC.backing: USDC deployed via the Spark Liquidity Layer
Spark Savings USDC::SPUSDC.yieldSource: lending interest on SparkLend/Aave/Morpho, RWA/T-bill yield, sUSDS

Spark Savings USDG::spUSDG.what: Spark Savings vault on USDG (Robinhood Chain) · Spark Liquidity Layer yield
Spark Savings USDG::spUSDG.body: spUSDG is a Spark Savings V2 vault (ERC-4626) on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663) that takes deposits of USDG, the Paxos-issued Global Dollar stablecoin. Spark deploys deposits through the Spark Liquidity Layer, and yield accrues to the share price. It launched as a Robinhood Chain day-one product.
Spark Savings USDG::spUSDG.backing: USDG deployed by the Spark Liquidity Layer
Spark Savings USDG::spUSDG.yieldSource: Spark Liquidity Layer deployments (Sky/USDS savings-rate linked)
Spark Savings USDG::spUSDG.redemption: Permissionless ERC-4626 withdraw to USDG, subject to vault liquidity

Spark Savings USDT::SPUSDT.what: Spark savings vault on USDT · SparkLend/Morpho lending, syrupUSDT, DEX LP
Spark Savings USDT::SPUSDT.body: spUSDT is a Spark Savings V2 ERC-4626 vault on Ethereum; deposited USDT earns a governance-set vault rate through a rising exchange rate. The Spark Liquidity Layer lends the USDT primarily on SparkLend, sends overflow to Morpho blue-chip vaults, makes a capped allocation to Maple's syrupUSDT, and places USDT in Curve/Uniswap pools; idle buffers earn the Sky Savings Rate via sUSDS. Spark describes the vault as backed by USDS.
Spark Savings USDT::SPUSDT.backing: USDT deployed via the Spark Liquidity Layer (backstopped by USDS)
Spark Savings USDT::SPUSDT.yieldSource: SparkLend and Morpho lending interest, capped syrupUSDT allocation, DEX fees, sUSDS on idle cash
Spark Savings USDT::SPUSDT.redemption: instant from a liquidity buffer; larger exits via liquidity intents, usually filled within minutes

Spark USDC Vault::sUSDC.what: Spark savings USDC (v1) · USDC routed into Sky Savings Rate via sUSDS
Spark USDC Vault::sUSDC.body: sUSDC is Spark's legacy (V1) ERC-4626 USDC savings vault, deployed on Ethereum and on Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Unichain. USDC deposits are swapped 1:1 into USDS/sUSDS through Sky's peg stability module (PSM3 on L2s), so holders earn the Sky Savings Rate through a rising exchange rate. The SSR is funded by Sky's stability fees and RWA/T-bill allocations.
Spark USDC Vault::sUSDC.backing: sUSDS held via Sky's PSM (PSM3 on L2s)
Spark USDC Vault::sUSDC.yieldSource: Sky Savings Rate (stability fees on crypto loans + RWA/T-bills)
Spark USDC Vault::sUSDC.redemption: instant 1:1 swap back to USDC at the current rate, no protocol fee

Staked Axis USD::SUSDX.what: Axis staked USDx · trading returns paid as rewards, 7-day request exit
Staked Axis USD::SUSDX.body: sUSDx is the ERC-4626 staking vault over Axis USDx (not Stables Labs' sUSDX). Axis funds rewards from its trading book every ~3 days, at its discretion, and they vest over 3 days into a rising sUSDx/USDx rate; the vault does not lend the staked USDx. The exit is an ERC-7540 request: requestRedeem burns the shares and fixes the payout, Axis's servicer processes it after 7 days, then the holder claims. On 2026-10-15 about a quarter of the vault was queued to exit.
Staked Axis USD::SUSDX.yieldSource: Axis trading returns, distributed as discretionary USDx rewards
Staked Axis USD::SUSDX.redemption: requestRedeem → serviced after 7 days → claim USDx; payout fixed at request; cancel currently disabled

Staked Falcon USD::sUSDf.what: Falcon staked USDf · funding/basis arb, cross-venue arb + altcoin staking
Staked Falcon USD::sUSDf.body: sUSDf is Falcon Finance's ERC-4626 vault on USDf, a synthetic dollar minted against stablecoins, BTC, ETH, altcoins and tokenized RWAs (gold, T-bills, equities). Yield shows up as a rising sUSDf/USDf exchange rate. It comes from mostly market-neutral trading of the collateral: positive and negative funding-rate arbitrage, spot/perp basis, cross-exchange arbitrage, native altcoin staking, DEX liquidity provision, options and statistical arbitrage.
Staked Falcon USD::sUSDf.backing: USDf (overcollateralized stablecoins, crypto and tokenized RWAs)
Staked Falcon USD::sUSDf.yieldSource: funding/basis arbitrage, cross-venue arbitrage, altcoin staking, LP and options
Staked Falcon USD::sUSDf.redemption: unstake sUSDf to USDf instantly; USDf redemption to stables 7-day cooldown, KYC required

Staked Forest Road USDfr::SUSDFR.what: Forest Road staked USDfr · specialty-finance loan interest, 21-day queued exit
Staked Forest Road USDfr::SUSDFR.body: sUSDfr is an ERC-4626 vault over USDfr, opened about 22 September 2026. Interest from Forest Road's loan facilities accrues into it continuously, less a 10 % performance fee, and an impairment source can mark declared losses into its price. The ~30 % APR it showed in October 2026 is real but comes from the whole book's interest landing on the roughly half of USDfr that is staked, so it dilutes as more is staked. Exits are throttled: after a 21-day hold a daily keeper settles requests out of about 1.67 % of idle reserves per epoch, priced at settlement.
Staked Forest Road USDfr::SUSDFR.backing: USDfr (USDC reserve plus Forest Road loan facilities)
Staked Forest Road USDfr::SUSDFR.yieldSource: interest from Forest Road specialty-finance facilities, less a 10 % performance fee
Staked Forest Road USDfr::SUSDFR.redemption: request through the redemption queue (approve shares), 21-day hold, FIFO daily settlement capped at ~1.67 % of idle reserves, then claim; no cancel
Staked Forest Road USDfr::SUSDFR.verify: Young and small (~$2.4M, opened Sep 2026), one originator; the headline rate will fall as staking grows.

Staked Frax USD::sfrxUSD.what: Frax staked frxUSD · rotates between carry trade, DeFi AMOs and T-bills
Staked Frax USD::sfrxUSD.body: sfrxUSD is a non-rebasing ERC-4626 vault for frxUSD whose redemption rate rises as yield is added. Frax's Benchmark Yield Strategy, governed by the Frax DAO, moves capital to the best of three sources: carry trades (e.g. Ethena, Superstate), DeFi yield via AMOs (Aave, Curve, Convex) and T-bill/RWA funds (e.g. BlackRock, FinresPBC).
Staked Frax USD::sfrxUSD.yieldSource: Benchmark Yield Strategy: carry trade, DeFi AMOs or T-bills/RWA
Staked Frax USD::sfrxUSD.redemption: permissionless, instant redeem to frxUSD, no unstaking fee

Staked HYPE::STHYPE.what: Valantis stHYPE · rebasing staked HYPE, the same ledger as wstHYPE
Staked HYPE::STHYPE.body: stHYPE is the rebasing balance token of Valantis's (formerly Thunderhead) HYPE liquid staking: HYPE is delegated to HyperCore validators and holders' balances grow with staking rewards (about 1.5 % APR in October 2026). It is a view of the same accounting as wstHYPE, the non-rebasing wrapper, about 1.036 HYPE per wstHYPE share, so the two are one $175M book. Upgrades sit behind a 48 h timelock and a 4-of-6 Safe.
Staked HYPE::STHYPE.redemption: unstake through Valantis (HyperCore unbonding) or trade

Staked InfiniFi USD::siUSD.what: infiniFi staked iUSD · fractional-reserve mix of Aave/Spark lending and Pendle PTs
Staked InfiniFi USD::siUSD.body: siUSD is the liquid staked form of iUSD, infiniFi's USDC-backed receipt dollar; yield is streamed in over 8-hour epochs and accrues in the siUSD price. infiniFi runs an on-chain fractional reserve: liquid deposits sit in liquid farms (Aave, Spark sUSDC) while capital locked as liUSD lets the protocol also allocate into longer-duration farms such as Pendle principal tokens. Protocol yield is shared between siUSD and liUSD holders, so siUSD earns more than the raw liquid lending rate; plain iUSD earns nothing. Since the June 2025 upgrade siUSD is no longer ERC-4626 and staking/unstaking go through infiniFi's Gateway.
Staked InfiniFi USD::siUSD.yieldSource: lending on Aave/Spark plus Pendle PT yield, boosted by locked-capital duration
Staked InfiniFi USD::siUSD.redemption: instant unstake to iUSD via Gateway; iUSD redeems 1:1 to USDC, queued if liquid reserves are short

Staked KAITO::sKAITO.what: Kaito staked KAITO · KAITO reward distributions, 7-day cooldown
Staked KAITO::sKAITO.body: sKAITO is Kaito's official staking vault on Base, an immutable ERC-4626 over the KAITO token built like Ethena's sUSDe. Kaito pays about 250k KAITO a month into it, vesting over 30 days, so sKAITO rises against KAITO (about 11.4 % APR in KAITO over 90 days, October 2026). Both yield and principal are KAITO, so the dollar value moves with KAITO's price. A 2-of-3 Safe can blacklist holders and move a blacklisted holder's balance.
Staked KAITO::sKAITO.redemption: cooldownShares, wait 7 days, then claim KAITO from the escrow

Staked Level USD::SLVLUSD.what: Level staked lvlUSD · was Aave/Morpho USDC-USDT lending; protocol wound down
Staked Level USD::SLVLUSD.body: slvlUSD is the ERC-4626 staking vault for lvlUSD, Level's dollar backed by USDC and USDT. The reserves were lent on blue-chip lending markets (Aave, Morpho) and all of that lending yield went to stakers through a rising slvlUSD/lvlUSD rate. In September 2025 the Level team joined Grove (Sky ecosystem) and sunset the protocol: minting stopped, the last yield distribution was on 2 October 2025, and the cooldown was cut to near-zero so holders can exit.
Staked Level USD::SLVLUSD.yieldSource: none since Oct 2025; previously Aave/Morpho lending interest
Staked Level USD::SLVLUSD.redemption: unstake to lvlUSD with near-zero cooldown, lvlUSD redeems 1:1; minting disabled, contract-only access after front-end shutdown
Staked Level USD::SLVLUSD.verify: Protocol sunset in late Sep 2025 (team acquired by Grove/Sky); no yield distributed since 2025-10-02. Issuer docs (docs.level.money) are offline; facts from news coverage.

Staked NUSD::sNUSD.what: Neutrl staked NUSD · hedged OTC altcoin discounts + basis; paused, redeeming ~0.51
Staked NUSD::sNUSD.body: sNUSD is the staking vault for NUSD, Neutrl's synthetic dollar minted against USDC, USDT or USDe, and took all protocol revenue through a rising exchange rate. Reserves bought discounted locked altcoins in OTC deals (via STIX) hedged with perp shorts, plus delta-neutral basis trades and yield-bearing stablecoins. On 13-14 August 2026 Neutrl paused minting and redemptions after a strategy position impaired reserve liquidity. A redemption portal run by Caverna Auctus Inc. opened 17 September 2026 paying USDC at a fixed rate of about 0.51 per token against disclosed liquid reserves, expected open until 14 November 2026.
Staked NUSD::sNUSD.backing: NUSD reserves: hedged OTC altcoins, basis positions, stablecoins (partly illiquid)
Staked NUSD::sNUSD.yieldSource: none currently; previously OTC discount capture, perp funding and stablecoin yield
Staked NUSD::sNUSD.redemption: protocol paused; one-off redemption portal at ~0.51 USDC per NUSD/sNUSD until 2026-11-14
Staked NUSD::sNUSD.verify: Reserve impairment: minting/redemptions paused Aug 2026, wind-down redemption at ~0.51 USDC; token is effectively depegged. Neutrl docs unreachable (HTTP 522); facts from news.

Staked Plasma USD::splUSD.what: Staked plUSD (Trevee, Plasma) · discontinued after the Nov 2025 Stream Finance collapse
Staked Plasma USD::splUSD.body: splUSD is the staked, auto-compounding form of Trevee's plUSD on Plasma: yield from the Midas vault's lending strategies (plus XPL rewards at launch) was minted as new plUSD into the staking contract. It traded as low as about $0.76-0.80 around the Stream Finance collapse in Nov 2025, when Trevee had about $14.7m lent to Stream. Trevee says splUSD holders were made whole, but Trevee's Plasma TVL is zero on DefiLlama, the Chainlink splUSD/plUSD feed was slated for deprecation in Sept 2026, and Euler's liquidation bot blacklists its vaults as collapsed collateral. The $10m the index shows as deposited is one frozen Euler esplUSD-1 position (10m splUSD backing about $8.7m of USDT0 debt), not live liquidity, and the $1 price is a stale oracle.
Staked Plasma USD::splUSD.backing: plUSD (USDT in a Midas vault on Plasma), with the Stream exposure in recovery
Staked Plasma USD::splUSD.yieldSource: lending yield from the Midas vault strategies, minted as plUSD into the staking contract; nothing observable since early 2026
Staked Plasma USD::splUSD.redemption: no working unstake or redeem path documented; only thin DEX liquidity near $0.99 on CoinGecko
Staked Plasma USD::splUSD.verify: Treat as discontinued: token-lists marks it DISCONTINUED (risk 5), DefiLlama shows $0 Plasma TVL for Trevee since early 2026, and Euler blacklists the splUSD vaults. No primary Trevee statement on redemption status was found.

Staked Stream USD::xUSD.what: Stream Finance staked USD · collapsed Nov 2025, in wind-down
Staked Stream USD::xUSD.body: xUSD is the staked vault token of Stream Finance, which deployed deposits into strategies run by external fund managers. In November 2025 Stream disclosed a ~$93M loss by an external manager, xUSD lost over 90% of its value, and the protocol is now in a wind-down to liquidate and distribute remaining assets to creditors.
Staked Stream USD::xUSD.redemption: Normal redemptions halted; recovery depends on Stream wind-down distributions
Staked Stream USD::xUSD.verify: Defunct: Stream Finance collapsed Nov 2025; xUSD trades near $0.02.

Staked USDS::stUSDS.what: Sky stUSDS · USDS lent to SKY stakers who borrow against SKY
Staked USDS::stUSDS.body: stUSDS is issued by Sky Protocol when USDS is supplied to the stUSDS module, which funds loans to SKY stakers borrowing against their staked SKY. Borrowed USDS earns the SKY borrow rate, and unused USDS earns the Sky Savings Rate. The module is isolated from sUSDS, so stUSDS holders bear losses if liquidations of SKY collateral do not cover the loans.
Staked USDS::stUSDS.backing: USDS loans secured by staked SKY
Staked USDS::stUSDS.yieldSource: SKY borrow rate, plus Sky Savings Rate on idle funds
Staked USDS::stUSDS.redemption: Permissionless withdraw to USDS, limited to unborrowed liquidity in the module

Staked USDu::sUSDu.what: Unitas staked USDu · JLP fees plus perp hedge, 7-day cooldown
Staked USDu::sUSDu.body: sUSDu is the staking vault over Unitas's USDu on BNB Chain, a clone of Ethena's sUSDe. USDu is a synthetic dollar whose collateral sits in Jupiter's JLP pool hedged with perp shorts, earning JLP fees and funding; staked returns vest into sUSDu over 8 hours, about 11 % APR on $36.8M in October 2026. Staking is permissionless, while USDu mint and redeem are for whitelisted institutions. A 3-of-5 Safe with no timelock holds blacklist powers.
Staked USDu::sUSDu.backing: USDu (JLP position hedged with perp shorts)
Staked USDu::sUSDu.yieldSource: JLP trading fees and perp funding
Staked USDu::sUSDu.redemption: cooldownShares, wait 7 days, unstake to USDu
Staked USDu::sUSDu.verify: Custody of the hedge positions is not verified.

Staked USDz::sUSDz.what: Anzen staked USDz · US private-credit ABS (SMB receivables, leases, loans)
Staked USDz::sUSDz.body: sUSDz is Anzen's staked form of USDz; the sUSDz balance stays the same while its USDz value rises as rewards are distributed. USDz is backed by a portfolio of overcollateralized, US-based private-credit asset-backed notes (e.g. SMB merchant receivables, invoice factoring, equipment and auto leases, installment loans) with concentration limits. Interest from those notes, net of reserves and fees, is passed to sUSDz.
Staked USDz::sUSDz.redemption: unstake sUSDz to USDz with a 7-day cooldown; USDz exit mainly via DEX liquidity
Staked USDz::sUSDz.verify: USDz supply has shrunk to under $10m on-chain (DefiLlama); docs show no wind-down, but check liquidity and whether the project is still active.

Staked UTY::YUTY.what: YieldPoint (ex-XSY) staked UTY · market-neutral perp funding and basis trades
Staked UTY::YUTY.body: yUTY is the yield-bearing vault share on UTY (Unity), YieldPoint's dollar token; YieldPoint is the rebrand of XSY. UTY is minted against USDC/USDT, which is moved to third-party custody and deployed into delta-neutral positions (originally long AVAX spot / short AVAX perps) that earn funding and basis. Those returns accrue to yUTY through a rising yUTY/UTY rate (1.1355 UTY, about 10.7 % APR in October 2026); plain UTY does not earn. The Base vault at 0xba515eed… is current and its asset is UTY at 0xba515304…, the address Pendle lists; Avalanche and Katana carry LayerZero copies.
Staked UTY::YUTY.backing: UTY (USDC/USDT with a custodian, deployed into delta-neutral positions)
Staked UTY::YUTY.yieldSource: perp funding rates and basis from hedged spot/perp positions
Staked UTY::YUTY.redemption: ERC-7540 on Base: requestRedeem fixes the payout, claim after the bonding period (0 today, owner-settable); UTY to USDC is an async redemption with YieldPoint

Staked UTY::yUTY.what: YieldPoint (ex-XSY) staked UTY · market-neutral perp funding and basis trades
Staked UTY::yUTY.body: yUTY is the yield-bearing vault share on UTY (Unity), YieldPoint's dollar token; YieldPoint is the rebrand of XSY. UTY is minted against USDC/USDT, which is moved to third-party custody and deployed into delta-neutral positions (originally long AVAX spot / short AVAX perps) that earn funding and basis. Those returns accrue to yUTY through a rising yUTY/UTY rate (1.1355 UTY, about 10.7 % APR in October 2026); plain UTY does not earn. The Base vault at 0xba515eed… is current and its asset is UTY at 0xba515304…, the address Pendle lists; Avalanche and Katana carry LayerZero copies.

Staked YUSD::sYUSD.what: Aegis staked YUSD · BTC collateral hedged with short perps, earns funding
Staked YUSD::sYUSD.body: sYUSD is the ERC-4626 staking vault for YUSD, Aegis's synthetic dollar backed by bitcoin held with institutional custodians (Fireblocks, Copper, Ceffu). The BTC is hedged with short BTC perpetuals on major exchanges, so the position is delta-neutral, and the funding paid by longs is the yield, compounded into a rising sYUSD/YUSD rate (about 4.3 % APR in October 2026). Fee and cooldown are admin dials on an upgradeable contract with no timelock observed.
Staked YUSD::sYUSD.backing: YUSD (custodied BTC hedged with short BTC perps)
Staked YUSD::sYUSD.redemption: free: cooldownShares, wait 7 days, unstake to YUSD; instant: redeem with a 50 bps fee to Aegis's insurance fund (previewRedeem does not show the fee)

Staked Yuzu USD::syzUSD.what: Staked yzUSD (ERC-4626) · weekly target yield from Yuzu's leveraged stablecoin book
Staked Yuzu USD::syzUSD.body: syzUSD is the ERC-4626 staking wrapper of yzUSD, the senior tranche of Yuzu Alpha. Each Friday Yuzu announces a target yield for the week's epoch and pays it in yzUSD into the vault, so the share price rises; the money comes from the collateral pool's strategies (Ethena USDe loops, Aave, Pendle, Euler, Fluid, Morpho, Spark, Maple, tokenized T-bills and CLOs), and Yuzu keeps a spread between earned and posted yield instead of a performance fee. Posted about 8% in Oct 2026 (12.5% in early epochs). Unstaking back to yzUSD is instant and permissionless; turning yzUSD into USDT0 needs Eligible Investor status or a DEX. Home chain is Plasma (about $59m); the Monad copy (about $10m) is bridged by LayerZero OFT and sits mostly in Euler and the YZM vault. Yuzu is active: $81m TVL and growing in Oct 2026, five Pashov/Dedaub audits to Jul 2026, OpenCover cover since Oct 2026.
Staked Yuzu USD::syzUSD.backing: yzUSD (senior claim on Yuzu Alpha's overcollateralized pool; yzPP absorbs first losses, then the Reserve Fund)
Staked Yuzu USD::syzUSD.yieldSource: weekly target yield set by Yuzu from leveraged DeFi stablecoin strategies (funding-rate arbitrage, loops, lending, T-bills, CLOs)
Staked Yuzu USD::syzUSD.redemption: unstake to yzUSD instantly from any wallet; yzUSD to USDT0 only for KYC'd Eligible Investors, else a DEX; Yuzu may pause exits on a suspected loss

Staked avUSD::savUSD.what: Avant staked avUSD · senior tranche of delta-neutral basis, lending and LP strategies
Staked avUSD::savUSD.body: savUSD is the ERC-4626 staking token on avUSD, Avant's dollar backed 1:1 by USDC on Avalanche, and is the senior tranche of Avant's yield. Deposits go to market-neutral strategies run with trading partners: spot/short-futures basis trades, lending-rate arbitrage, Pendle yield trading, Aave supply and Curve/Uniswap liquidity. Profits raise the savUSD/avUSD rate, and the junior avUSDx tranche takes strategy losses first.
Staked avUSD::savUSD.backing: avUSD (USDC), protected by the avUSDx junior tranche
Staked avUSD::savUSD.yieldSource: basis trades, lending arbitrage, Pendle, Aave, DEX liquidity
Staked avUSD::savUSD.redemption: 1-day cooldown savUSD to avUSD (no yield during it); avUSD redeems to USDC

Staked cap USD::stcUSD.what: Cap staked cUSD · loans to restaker-covered market makers + Aave on idle USDC
Staked cap USD::stcUSD.body: stcUSD is the ERC-4626 staking vault for cUSD, Cap's dollar backed 1:1 by stablecoin reserves (USDC). Institutional operators such as market makers and trading firms borrow from the reserve, and their credit is covered by restaked collateral delegated via Symbiotic/EigenLayer that is slashed on default. stcUSD earns the borrow interest above the hurdle rate plus underwriting premiums, and idle reserves are swept into Aave V3.
Staked cap USD::stcUSD.backing: cUSD (USDC reserve, lent to operators covered by restakers)
Staked cap USD::stcUSD.yieldSource: operator borrow interest and underwriting premiums, plus Aave yield on idle reserve
Staked cap USD::stcUSD.redemption: unstake to cUSD; cUSD redeems from the reserve's unlent buffer

Staked infiniFi USD::siUSD.what: infiniFi staked iUSD · fractional-reserve mix of Aave/Spark lending and Pendle PTs
Staked infiniFi USD::siUSD.body: siUSD is the liquid staked form of iUSD, infiniFi's USDC-backed receipt dollar; yield is streamed in over 8-hour epochs and accrues in the siUSD price. infiniFi runs an on-chain fractional reserve: liquid deposits sit in liquid farms (Aave, Spark sUSDC) while capital locked as liUSD lets the protocol also allocate into longer-duration farms such as Pendle principal tokens. Protocol yield is shared between siUSD and liUSD holders, so siUSD earns more than the raw liquid lending rate; plain iUSD earns nothing. Since the June 2025 upgrade siUSD is no longer ERC-4626 and staking/unstaking go through infiniFi's Gateway.
Staked infiniFi USD::siUSD.yieldSource: lending on Aave/Spark plus Pendle PT yield, boosted by locked-capital duration
Staked infiniFi USD::siUSD.redemption: instant unstake to iUSD via Gateway; iUSD redeems 1:1 to USDC, queued if liquid reserves are short

Strata Junior USDat::JRUSDAT.body: jrUSDat is the junior (first-loss) tranche of Strata's Saturn market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled sUSDat. sUSDat holds T-bills and Strategy's STRC preferred stock; jrUSDat keeps the returns left after paying srUSDat its fixed 65%-of-STRC-dividend yield. Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.what: Strata junior tranche of sUSDe · levered residual sUSDe yield, first-loss cover for senior
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.body: jrUSDe is the junior (first-loss) tranche of Strata's Ethena market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled sUSDe. It gets the sUSDe yield (Ethena funding/basis carry) left after srUSDe is paid its floor, plus the senior's risk premium, so it beats sUSDe when funding is high. When sUSDe yield falls below the Aave benchmark, or on an Ethena loss, jrUSDe pays the shortfall, so its exchange rate can fall and principal can be lost.
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.backing: USDe staked as sUSDe; subordinated to srUSDe
Strata Junior USDe::jrUSDe.yieldSource: residual sUSDe yield (perp funding + basis) after paying senior, plus senior risk premium

Strata Junior mHYPER::JRMHYPER.body: jrmHYPER is the junior (first-loss) tranche of Strata's mHYPER market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled Midas mHYPER (Hyperithm's multi-chain stablecoin yield strategy). It keeps the mHYPER returns left after srmHYPER is paid its Aave+3% floor, plus a risk premium. It covers that floor and any mHYPER strategy or counterparty losses first, so returns can go negative.
Strata Junior mHYPER::JRMHYPER.yieldSource: residual mHYPER strategy returns after paying senior, plus senior risk premium
Strata Junior mHYPER::JRMHYPER.redemption: cooldown 0-21 days and 0-20 bps fee by senior coverage (+up to 3 days to USDC); paused below min coverage

Strata Junior nOPAL::JRNOPAL.body: jrnOPAL is the junior (first-loss) tranche of Strata's nOPAL market. It keeps the nOPAL return left after paying srnOPAL its protected rate and takes credit losses on Nest's nOPAL (BlackOpal LiquidStone II private credit) before the senior does; Neutrl's collapse showed how a Strata junior can be wiped out. The pool is accounted in USDC but accepts and pays only nOPAL. About $384k in October 2026.

Strata Junior nOPAL::JRNOPAL.yieldSource: residual nOPAL private-credit returns after the senior is paid

Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.what: Strata senior tranche of Neutrl sNUSD · impaired with NUSD (~$0.63/share), deposits shut
Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.body: srNUSD is the senior tranche of Strata's Neutrl market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled NUSD staked as sNUSD, junior-protected. Neutrl's August 2026 reserve impairment cut NUSD to a 0.51 USDC recovery rate; that loss exceeded jrNUSD's cover, which went to ~0, and the senior took the rest. On 2026-10-17 one srNUSD converted to 1.2397 NUSD, about $0.63 at the portal rate, Strata's own feed marks it 0.632 and both tranches read maxDeposit = 0.

Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.redemption: to sNUSD through Strata's cooldown contracts, then NUSD (sNUSD cooldown 1 s) into Neutrl's 0.51 USDC portal until 2026-11-14
Strata Senior NUSD::srNUSD.verify: Impaired: Neutrl NUSD reserve loss (Aug 2026) wiped the junior and marked the senior to ~0.63 USD per share; no yield.

Strata Senior USDat::SRUSDAT.what: Strata senior tranche of Saturn sUSDat · fixed 65% of STRC dividend, junior covers NAV
Strata Senior USDat::SRUSDAT.body: srUSDat is the senior (protected) tranche of Strata's Saturn market, an ERC-4626 token over pooled sUSDat. sUSDat earns T-bill interest and dividends on Strategy's STRC preferred stock, and its NAV moves with STRC's price. srUSDat targets a fixed yield of 65% of the STRC dividend rate; jrUSDat absorbs STRC price swings and losses first, but it was only ~16 % of the pool in October 2026 after the mid-2026 sUSDat drawdown halved it. On Monad, srUSDat is a LayerZero OFT copy of the Ethereum token (an adapter locks the Ethereum shares 1:1), not a separate Strata deployment.

Strata Senior USDat::SRUSDAT.yieldSource: STRC preferred dividends and T-bill interest; senior fixed at 65% of STRC dividend rate
Strata Senior USDat::SRUSDAT.redemption: permissionless on Ethereum; redeem to sUSDat through the cooldown contract (0 s on this leg); 0-5 bps fee by coverage; mint paused below 107.5% coverage; Monad copies bridge back first

Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.what: Strata senior tranche of sUSDe · Aave-rate floor, junior first-loss cover, sUSDe upside
Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.body: srUSDe is the senior (protected) tranche of Strata's Ethena market: an ERC-4626 token whose exchange rate to USDe only rises. The pooled USDe is staked as sUSDe, which earns Ethena's perp funding/basis carry plus staking yield; srUSDe takes a share of that with a floor at the supply-weighted Aave v3 Core USDC/USDT lending rate, paying a risk premium to jrUSDe. jrUSDe is first-loss capital, so srUSDe only loses principal if the junior tranche is wiped out.

Strata Senior USDe::SRUSDE.redemption: permissionless; instant redeem to sUSDe or USDe after Ethena's 7-day cooldown; 2.5 bps fee; mint paused if coverage < 105%

USDai::USDAI.body: USDai is USD.AI's non-yielding synthetic dollar and the entry token to its GPU-loan protocol. The docs describe backing by Treasuries and cash equivalents but state it is currently 100% backed by PYUSD locked in the protocol, with no private-key minting; it carries no exposure to the GPU loans, which sit in sUSDai. Minted on Arbitrum (the hub), Ethereum, Base and Plasma and bridged by LayerZero OFT. From Q2 2026 direct mint and redeem are limited to KYC-verified market makers and institutional depositors; everyone else buys on a DEX or CEX and stakes on app.usd.ai. About $347m in Oct 2026, almost all on Arbitrum; the Plasma supply shrank from about $150m to under $1m during 2026.

Wrapped iTRY::WITRY.body: wiTRY is the ERC-4626 vault share on iTRY, Brix's Turkish-lira token backed by a tokenized basket of liquid Turkish money market funds. Each cycle (currently weekly) Brix measures the funds' NAV gain and mints the lira-denominated yield into the vault, so wiTRY redeems for more iTRY over time. Wren Staked tGBP::wstGBP.body: wstGBP is a non-rebasing ERC-20 wrapper around tGBP, the sterling stablecoin issued by FCA-registered BCP Technologies. A commercial agreement between BCP and Wren Spire passes part of the income from tGBP's reserves (UK gilts, sterling cash and money market funds) to the wrapper. That income lands as periodic NAV updates to the wstGBP/tGBP rate, which is in GBP, not USD.

Yield Optimizer BTC::YOBTC.what: YO cbBTC vault · currently holds idle cbBTC and earns nothing
Yield Optimizer BTC::YOBTC.body: yoBTC is the share token of YO Protocol's cbBTC vault, an operator-managed ERC-4626. In October 2026 almost all of its cbBTC sat idle in the vault (mostly on Ethereum), and its 1-, 7- and 30-day yields were 0%. YO can deploy it into lending markets at any time. Shares are priced by YO's own oracle: an updater posts the share price, which can move at most 0.1% a day. The same vault address runs on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum with one share price, and the operator moves assets between chains. In January 2026 a YO operator swap in the yoUSD vault lost about $3.7M to slippage (covered by the team); the same operator setup, a 4-of-6 Safe with no timelock and an EOA price updater, runs this vault.
Yield Optimizer BTC::YOBTC.backing: cbBTC, nearly all held idle (Ethereum ~78%, Base ~22%)
Yield Optimizer BTC::YOBTC.redemption: Instant from the vault's idle balance on that chain; anything larger is queued until YO's operator fulfils it (0.001% fee)

Yield Optimizer USD Edge::YOUSDEDGE.body: yoUSD Edge is YO Protocol's riskier USDC vault, an operator-managed ERC-4626 that YO itself rates 'moderate'. It lends USDC and USDG on markets whose collateral is Pendle PT-reUSD, fxSAVE, syrupUSDG and cbXRP. Shares are priced by YO's own oracle: an updater posts the share price, which can move at most 0.1% a day. The same vault address runs on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum with one share price, and the operator moves assets between chains. In January 2026 a YO operator swap in the yoUSD vault lost about $3.7M to slippage (covered by the team); the same operator setup, a 4-of-6 Safe with no timelock and an EOA price updater, runs this vault.

Yield Optimizer USD::YOUSD.body: yoUSD is the share token of YO Protocol's USDC vault, an operator-managed ERC-4626. YO deploys the USDC into overcollateralized lending markets, mostly on Base, borrowed against cbBTC, WETH and wstETH. Shares are priced by YO's own oracle: an updater posts the share price, which can move at most 0.1% a day. The same vault address runs on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum with one share price, and the operator moves assets between chains. On 12-13 January 2026 an operator rebalancing swap in this vault (stkGHO to USDC through Odos, with no effective slippage limit) lost about $3.7M; YO covered the loss from its own funds. The same operator setup still runs the vaults: a 4-of-6 Safe with no timelock over strategy calls and an EOA that posts the share price.

Yuzu Money Vault::YZM.body: YZM is the ERC-4626 share of the Yuzu Money Vault on Accountable's YieldApp on Monad, launched Dec 2025 with a $10m cap that filled in days plus MON incentives. Deposits are USDC and the vault's core position is syzUSD, so the share price follows syzUSD's weekly yield less a 3% performance fee (no management, deposit or withdrawal fee); Accountable's Proof of Solvency verifies the vault's assets. It peaked near $20m and held about $2.2m in Oct 2026 with the share at about 1.06 USDC. On Monad it is collateral on Morpho (YZM/AUSD, YZM/USDC) and Curvance (YZM/AUSD).

Yield accrues continuously into NAV with no weekly epochs; Accountable attests the backing (100.25% on 2026-10-14, about $7.6m, posted about 6.8%). Minted and redeemed for USDC at NAV by KYC-checked Eligible Investors only; anyone can hold it via DEXs.

Yuzu Protection Pool::yzPP.what: Yuzu Alpha junior tranche · first loss on the strategy book for a higher target yield
Yuzu Protection Pool::yzPP.body: yzPP is the first-loss tranche of Yuzu Alpha. It sits in the same backing pool as yzUSD and absorbs strategy losses before yzUSD does, with the Reserve Fund as the layer after it. In return it earns the syzUSD base yield plus a protocol-funded risk premium set daily at 04:00 UTC (posted about 24% on $6.5m in Oct 2026). Minted with USDT0 on Plasma by KYC-checked Eligible Investors only; the Monad token is a LayerZero OFT copy.
Yuzu Protection Pool::yzPP.backing: subordinated claim on Yuzu Alpha's collateral pool
Yuzu Protection Pool::yzPP.yieldSource: syzUSD base yield plus a daily protocol-funded risk premium, partly paid from the Reserve Fund
Yuzu Protection Pool::yzPP.redemption: 30-day redemption period, minimum 5,000 yzPP, cancellable after 24 h; all yzPP minting and redemption pause after any loss until Yuzu finishes assessing it; Eligible Investors only

Yuzu USD::yzUSD.what: Yuzu Alpha senior tranche · $1 token backed >100% by a leveraged DeFi carry book on Plasma
Yuzu USD::yzUSD.body: yzUSD is the senior, non-yielding tranche of Yuzu Alpha. Only KYC/KYB-checked Eligible Investors (accredited, qualified or institutional; no retail) mint and redeem it 1:1 against USDT0. The collateral pool is a leveraged stablecoin carry book run from Fordefi MPC wallets across Aave, Pendle, Euler, Fluid, Morpho, Spark and Curvance, with Ethena USDe loops the largest slice, plus tokenized T-bills, AAA CLOs and Maple lending; Accountable attests the backing in near real time (collateral ratio 111.8% on 2026-10-14, about $59m of yzUSD, nearly all on Plasma). Losses hit the yzPP junior tranche first, then the Reserve Fund, and an OpenCover Covered Vault adds up to $50m of cover since Oct 2026. Holders stake into syzUSD to earn.
Yuzu USD::yzUSD.backing: USDT0 deployed into leveraged DeFi stablecoin strategies (USDe loops, Aave, Pendle, Euler, Fluid, Morpho, Spark, Maple, tokenized T-bills and CLOs); overcollateralized, yzPP takes first loss
Yuzu USD::yzUSD.redemption: Eligible Investors redeem 1:1 for USDT0 through Yuzu after KYC/KYB; Yuzu may pause mint, redeem and exits on any suspected loss; everyone else sells on DEXs (Plasma is the deep venue, Monad is thin)

aptUSD::APTUSD.body: aptUSD is Apyx's T-bill savings token: a second instance of the apyUSD vault contract over alqUSD ('Apyx Liquid USD'), separate from the apxUSD preferred-stock product. Apyx sets the payout rate (around the Fed Funds lower bound) and streams it through a 10-day linear vest into a rising share price, about 3.8 % APR in October 2026. A redeem pays nothing at once: it escrows alqUSD in an unlock-receipt NFT that is claimable free after 1 day, although Apyx's docs say there is no unlock period. Apyx's own app exits through the Curve aptUSD/alqUSD and Uniswap pools.

It pays no yield itself; holders lock it into apyUSD to receive the preferred-share dividends. Because the collateral is preferred equity rather than cash, its value moves with those shares, and apxUSD traded around $0.92-0.93 in early June 2026 when STRC fell below par.

apxUSD::APXUSD.verify: Fell to ~$0.92 in Jun 2026; the peg follows preferred-share prices, not cash reserves.

evaETH::EVAETH.what: eva · 1:1 wrapper of Wildcat's unsecured WETH loan to Wintermute; earns 0 % itself
evaETH::EVAETH.body: evaETH is an ERC-4626 vault and LayerZero token in one contract, minted 1:1 for WETH on Ethereum. Every deposit goes into Wildcat's wmtWETH market, an unsecured WETH loan to the trading firm Wintermute at 3.75 % fixed. The token itself earns nothing: its price is fixed at 1 WETH, and eva mints the loan's interest to its own operator to pay liquidity-pool incentives (Curve, Stake DAO, Convex). Holders still carry the full credit risk of the loan. eva has closed it to new deposits; holders can still redeem.

evaETH::EVAETH.yieldSource: none to the holder; the loan's 3.75 % is minted to eva's operator and paid out as LP incentives
evaETH::EVAETH.redemption: Ethereum only: request a redemption, eva's operator queues it into a Wildcat 24 h withdrawal batch, then claim once Wintermute has repaid into it; 2 WETH minimum. Other chains bridge to Ethereum first

limUSD::LIMUSD.what: Liminal limUSD · allocator over delta-neutral Hyperliquid funding and lending xTokens
limUSD::LIMUSD.body: limUSD is Liminal's USD allocator on HyperEVM (LayerZero copies on Ethereum and Arbitrum). It spreads deposits over Liminal's xTokens: delta-neutral HYPE and BTC carry positions on Hyperliquid that earn perp funding and staking yield, and a lending sleeve. Its price is not computed on-chain: Liminal posts the NAV (bounded per update), and price per share = NAV / supply (1.0362 USDC on 2026-10-16, about 8 % APR on $8.9M). Liminal takes 10 % of performance on top of the xTokens' own fees.

Around 20 June 2026 its proof-of-reserves dashboard went offline and Accountable ended its attestation; the buffer ran dry, redemptions stopped and msUSD fell to about $0.06. It traded back to about $0.54-0.56 by October 2026 with no redemption path reopened, while lending oracles (Euler) still read 1.0.

sBold::sBOLD.what: K3 Capital sBOLD · BOLD in Liquity V2 stability pools (WETH/wstETH/rETH)
sBold::sBOLD.body: sBOLD is a non-upgradeable ERC-4626 built by K3 Capital over Liquity V2's BOLD. It splits deposits across the WETH (30 %), wstETH (60 %) and rETH (10 %) stability pools, which earn 75 % of borrower interest plus collateral from liquidations; anyone can call swap() to sell that collateral back into BOLD, and until then oracles value it. Deposits and withdrawals stop while unswapped collateral exceeds 7,500 BOLD, while paused, or if an oracle fails. A 2-of-3 Safe with no timelock sets the swap adapter, oracles and fees.

sBold::sBOLD.yieldSource: Liquity V2 borrower interest (stability-pool share) and liquidation gains

sDOLA::SDOLA.what: Inverse Finance staked DOLA · FiRM fixed-rate borrower DBR revenue
sDOLA::SDOLA.body: sDOLA is an ERC-4626 wrapper around Inverse Finance's DOLA Savings Account; its exchange rate rises as revenue accrues. FiRM borrowers pay for fixed-rate loans by spending DBR (DOLA Borrowing Rights); part of that revenue goes to the savings account as DBR, which is converted to DOLA through the DAO's XY=K auction and compounded weekly, with no set minimum or maximum rate. Deposited DOLA is not rehypothecated. It is the senior layer under jrDOLA, which holds its deposits as sDOLA and takes FiRM bad debt first; sDOLA lives on Ethereum only, its CCIP bridge lanes having been shut down.
sDOLA::SDOLA.backing: DOLA held in the DOLA Savings Account
sDOLA::SDOLA.yieldSource: DBR revenue from FiRM fixed-rate lending, auctioned into DOLA
sDOLA::SDOLA.redemption: permissionless, instant unwrap to DOLA, no penalty

Its ~5.8 % APR is 2.26 % net interest plus a 3.56 % DAWN-funded stream paid in USD.infra into the share price, scheduled to end 2026-10-23.

sUSD1+::sUSD1+.body: sUSD1+ is the non-rebasing share of Lorenzo Protocol's USD1+ On-chain Traded Fund on BNB Chain, run with World Liberty Financial's USD1; USD1+ is the rebasing version of the same fund. Deposits of USD1, USDT or USDC go into three sleeves: tokenized real-world assets, a delta-neutral basis strategy on centralized exchanges, and DeFi yield. Returns are settled in USD1 and show up as a rising NAV per sUSD1+.
sUSD1+::sUSD1+.backing: USD1+ OTF assets (RWA, CEX basis positions, DeFi), settled in USD1
sUSD1+::sUSD1+.yieldSource: RWA interest, CEX delta-neutral basis/funding, DeFi yield
sUSD1+::sUSD1+.redemption: withdrawal request on a rolling cycle, paid in USD1 about 7-14 days later at the NAV on the processing date
sUSD1+::sUSD1+.verify: Lorenzo's GitBook has no USD1+ page; the mix comes from launch coverage. Part of the strategy runs off-chain on CEXs, with custody.

sUSDS::SUSDS.what: Sky savings rate on USDS · RWA T-bills + crypto-collateral loan fees
sUSDS::SUSDS.body: sUSDS is Sky's (ex-MakerDAO) non-rebasing ERC-4626 vault for USDS; its exchange rate rises every block at the Sky Savings Rate (SSR) set by Sky governance. The rate is paid out of Sky's protocol revenue: stability fees on USDS borrowed against ETH, wstETH and other crypto collateral, tokenized T-bill and other RWA allocations, and capital deployed by Sky's allocators such as the Spark Liquidity Layer. Deposited USDS itself is not lent out; it sits in the savings contract.
sUSDS::SUSDS.backing: USDS held in the Sky Savings Rate contract
sUSDS::SUSDS.yieldSource: Sky revenue: stability fees on crypto-collateral loans, RWA/T-bill allocations, allocator (Spark) yield
sUSDS::SUSDS.redemption: permissionless, instant redeem to USDS at current exchange rate; no fees

sUSDai::SUSDAI.what: USD.AI staked USDai · GPU-backed loans to AI data centers + T-bills on idle cash
sUSDai::SUSDAI.body: sUSDai is the staked form of USDai, USD.AI's dollar that its docs say is 100% backed by PYUSD. Staked capital funds non-recourse loans to AI infrastructure operators at 70-80% LTV, 3-year amortization and 7-15% APR, each held in a bankruptcy-remote Delaware SPV that owns the GPUs (NVIDIA B200, B300, H200) and their revenue contracts, with about three months of debt service in reserve and Wilmington Trust as escrow; capital not yet lent sits in short-term T-bills. Loan interest and T-bill yield raise the sUSDai/USDai rate (about 6.9% on about $548m in Oct 2026; the protocol's TVL swung from $690m in Dec 2025 to $170m in Aug 2026 and back to $350m). sUSDai is not a stablecoin and is not redeemable at par on demand.
sUSDai::SUSDAI.backing: USDai (PYUSD) lent against GPU hardware in Delaware SPVs; idle capital in T-bills
sUSDai::SUSDAI.yieldSource: interest on GPU-collateralized loans plus T-bill yield
sUSDai::SUSDAI.redemption: 30-day epochs: queue on days 1-29, FIFO payout on day 30 from undeployed USDai, any unfilled remainder rolls to the next epoch; loans are never liquidated to pay exits, so high utilization stretches the queue; a small instant buffer exists
sUSDai::SUSDAI.issuer: USD.AI (USD.AI Foundation, Cayman Islands; built by Permian Labs)

stETH ARM LP Token::ARM-WETH-STETH.what: Lido ARM LP (Origin) · WETH buys stETH at a discount, redeems via Lido's queue
stETH ARM LP Token::ARM-WETH-STETH.body: The Lido ARM (Automated Redemption Manager) is Origin's stETH/WETH market maker. LPs deposit WETH; the ARM buys stETH slightly below 1:1 from sellers who want an instant exit and redeems it 1:1 through Lido's withdrawal queue, earning the spread, and lends idle WETH. The LP token is an ERC-4626 over WETH (about 1,880 WETH and 2.4 % APR in October 2026), and its price can dip if stETH is held through a depeg.
stETH ARM LP Token::ARM-WETH-STETH.backing: WETH and stETH waiting in Lido's withdrawal queue
stETH ARM LP Token::ARM-WETH-STETH.yieldSource: discount captured buying stETH and redeeming it through Lido's queue, plus lending idle WETH
stETH ARM LP Token::ARM-WETH-STETH.redemption: request a redeem, then claim WETH after a short delay, subject to the ARM having WETH
stETH ARM LP Token::ARM-WETH-STETH.verify: Exit delay and fees were not re-checked.

vaSTETH Pool::vaSTETH.what: Vesper pool share on stETH · stETH staking plus strategy yield
vaSTETH Pool::vaSTETH.body: vaSTETH is the share token of Vesper Finance's stETH pool (underlying token is Lido stETH). Deposited stETH keeps its staking rewards, and Vesper strategies have used it as collateral to borrow stablecoins that are deployed in other yield venues, with profits converted back into stETH. The pool share's stETH value rises as that yield accrues. It is also accepted as collateral on Metronome Synth.
vaSTETH Pool::vaSTETH.backing: Lido stETH deposited in the Vesper pool
vaSTETH Pool::vaSTETH.yieldSource: stETH staking rewards plus Vesper strategy profits paid in stETH
vaSTETH Pool::vaSTETH.redemption: Withdraw from the Vesper pool for stETH, subject to pool liquidity; no KYC

xHYPE::XHYPE.what: Liminal xHYPE · delta-neutral HYPE (spot/LST long + perp short), earns funding
xHYPE::XHYPE.body: xHYPE is one of Liminal's delta-neutral 'xTokens' on Hyperliquid: it holds HYPE (partly as liquid staking tokens) and shorts an equal amount of HYPE perps, so it earns perp funding plus staking yield with little HYPE price exposure. About 8.9 % APR on $8.5M in October 2026; Liminal takes 10 % of funding gains. Negative funding lowers the value.
xHYPE::XHYPE.backing: spot HYPE/LSTs hedged with HYPE perp shorts on Hyperliquid
xHYPE::XHYPE.yieldSource: HYPE perp funding plus staking yield, minus a 10 % performance fee
xHYPE::XHYPE.redemption: through Liminal (instant buffer or queued, as for limUSD)
xHYPE::XHYPE.verify: xHYPE contract and exit terms were not checked.

yoTest::yoTest.what: YO's test USDC vault · experimental strategy, $1M cap
yoTest::yoTest.body: yoTest is a USDC vault YO Protocol runs as a test, with a $1M deposit cap and a 'moderate' rating from YO. It holds live deposits (about $14k in October 2026) lent on Ethereum and HyperEVM against PT-reUSD, WHYPE, kHYPE and fxSAVE. A test product, with no commitment that it will be maintained.
yoTest::yoTest.backing: USDC lent on Ethereum and HyperEVM against PT-reUSD, WHYPE, kHYPE, fxSAVE
yoTest::yoTest.redemption: Instant from the vault's idle balance on that chain; anything larger is queued until YO's operator fulfils it (0.001% fee)
yoTest::yoTest.verify: Test vault: YO names it a test product; do not treat it as a maintained vault

yoUSDT::yoUSDT.what: USDT entry to YO's yoUSD · forwards 95% of deposits into yoUSD, priced as yoUSD
yoUSDT::yoUSDT.body: yoUSDT is a YO Protocol vault on Ethereum that takes USDT deposits, forwards 95% of each deposit into the yoUSD vault, and keeps 5% as USDT for redemptions. Its shares are priced from yoUSD's share price, so a holder earns yoUSD's yield. Small: about $13k in October 2026. In January 2026 a YO operator swap in the yoUSD vault lost about $3.7M to slippage (covered by the team); the same operator setup, a 4-of-6 Safe with no timelock and an EOA price updater, runs this vault.
yoUSDT::yoUSDT.redemption: Instant from the 5% USDT buffer; anything larger is queued until YO's operator fulfils it

yzPP::Yuzu Protection Pool.what: Yuzu Alpha junior tranche · first loss on the strategy book for a higher target yield
yzPP::Yuzu Protection Pool.body: yzPP is the first-loss tranche of Yuzu Alpha. It sits in the same backing pool as yzUSD and absorbs strategy losses before yzUSD does, with the Reserve Fund as the layer after it. In return it earns the syzUSD base yield plus a protocol-funded risk premium set daily at 04:00 UTC (posted about 24% on $6.5m in Oct 2026). Minted with USDT0 on Plasma by KYC-checked Eligible Investors only; the Monad token is a LayerZero OFT copy.
yzPP::Yuzu Protection Pool.backing: subordinated claim on Yuzu Alpha's collateral pool
yzPP::Yuzu Protection Pool.yieldSource: syzUSD base yield plus a daily protocol-funded risk premium, partly paid from the Reserve Fund
yzPP::Yuzu Protection Pool.redemption: 30-day redemption period, minimum 5,000 yzPP, cancellable after 24 h; all yzPP minting and redemption pause after any loss until Yuzu finishes assessing it; Eligible Investors only
